deliberate_boundaries.topic: SAM2 portable preset and research checkpoint fragment limits
deliberate_boundaries.status: The portable SAM2 presets retain a 500000 raw-point fragment limit; the selected-proposal epoch-150 research checkpoint used a 100000-point cap.
deliberate_boundaries.reason: A shared selected-proposal objective does not make the portable preset an exact reproduction of the research training contract. The point cap, schedule, checkpoint identity and fixed-evaluation contract must remain explicit.
